page.importDescription: Bring your clients and already issued invoices into GNERAI OS. Everything is simulated row by row first; nothing is saved until you confirm, and re-importing the same file doesn't duplicate anything.
page.partnerOnly: Only a partner or owner can import.

clients.title: Clients and contacts
clients.description: A CSV (or an Excel file saved as CSV) with one row per client or per contact.
clients.point1: It recognizes existing clients by NIF or name and only fills in what they're missing.
clients.point2: Several rows with the same NIF are the same client: each one can bring a contact.
clients.point3: It validates NIF, NIE and CIF, emails, countries and postcodes before saving anything.

invoices.title: Historical invoices
invoices.description: Invoices already issued in the invoicing app, in Excel or in another tool: one row per invoice or one per line.
invoices.point1: They keep their number; the series counter continues after the last one imported.
invoices.point2: Each line is classified as recurring, one-off or usage by keywords, and you can correct it.
invoices.point3: Amounts are reconciled with what the invoice printed. It also accepts the invoicing app's JSON.

page.jobsDescription: The last 20. A confirmed one stays as a record of what was imported.
page.exportDescription: Prepare a package by issuer and period with issued invoices, expenses, receipts, and available attachments. The manifest flags missing documents and receipts without an issuer; review the close with your accountant.

upload.hint: Drag the file here or choose it: CSV (with “;” or “,”, UTF-8 or Windows-1252) or the invoicing app's JSON. 5 MB max.

errors.generic: The file couldn't be read. Please try again.
errors.origin: The upload must be done from GNERAI OS.
errors.permission: Only a partner or owner can import.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB: split it into several.
errors.xlsx: It's an Excel file (.xlsx): save it as “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)” from File → Save As and upload it again.
errors.json_unsupported: This JSON isn't the invoicing app's history. For other data, use a CSV.
errors.no_rows: The file only has the header row.
errors.too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows: split it into several.
errors.too_many_columns: The file has more than 120 columns: remove the ones you don't need.

job.discardBody: The uploaded file and its simulation are deleted. Nothing has been imported, so no client or invoice is touched.
job.sameFile: This same file was already imported on {date}. If you import it again, whatever's already there is skipped: nothing will change.
job.failed: The last confirmation didn't finish. Whatever got imported isn't duplicated: you can confirm again.

mapping.title: Columns
mapping.description: Which column in the file holds each field. They're suggested automatically from the headers; change them if needed and save to simulate.
mapping.mappedCount: {count, plural, one {# field mapped} other {# fields mapped}} out of {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}

requiredGroups.base: an amount (base, line amount or price)

options.issuerHint: Who issued these invoices (its series and counter).
options.issuerFromFile: Each row's issuer NIF is used; this one is for the rows that don't include it.

paidHint.all: They're marked as paid on their due date (never in the future): they're historical.
paidHint.column: Paid if they have a payment date or a status such as “paid”; the rest, outstanding.
paidHint.none: They stay outstanding (and overdue, if their due date has passed).

options.defaultVatHint: Only for invoices where the file doesn't let us work it out.

fieldHints.display_name: If there isn't one, the legal name is used.
fieldHints.external_id: The ID in the source tool: it recognizes the client when re-importing.
fieldHints.contact_email: Creates a contact (the first one, for billing).
fieldHints.issuer_tax_id: Only if the file mixes issuers.
fieldHints.kind: “Rectifying”, “R”, “credit note”… If there's a corrected invoice, it already is one.
fieldHints.billing_type: Monthly, yearly, one-off, usage… Otherwise, by keywords in the description.
fieldHints.line_amount: The line's base; if there isn't one, quantity × price.
fieldHints.vat_rate: Each line's; if there isn't one, it's worked out from the VAT amount.
fieldHints.vat_amount: The invoice's (repeated on each row if there's one row per line).
fieldHints.irpf_rate: If there isn't one, it's worked out from the withholding or the total.
fieldHints.base: The invoice's: it checks that the lines add up to it.
fieldHints.total: The invoice's: it checks base + VAT − IRPF.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.clientsDescription: What would be done with each row if you confirm now. Nothing has been saved yet.
simulation.invoicesDescription: What would be done with each invoice if you confirm now. Above all, check each line's type: recurring, usage and one-off never mix in the metrics.

stats.skipped: {count, plural, one {# already imported} other {# already imported}}
stats.errors: {count, plural, one {# with an error} other {# with errors}}
stats.newClients: {count, plural, =0 {No new clients} one {# new client} other {# new clients}}

simulation.counterUp: The counter for series {series} ({year}) goes from {from} to {to}: the next invoice GNERAI OS issues will be number {next}.
simulation.counterKept: The counter for series {series} ({year}) stays at {from}: it was already ahead.
simulation.gap: Series {series} ({year}): {count, plural, one {# number is missing} other {# numbers are missing}} in GNERAI OS ({ranges}). If they were issued elsewhere, import them too.
simulation.legacyCounter: The invoicing app reached number {last} in {year}, but the file only goes up to {imported} (the app only kept the last 20). Set the last number in Settings → Issuers before issuing.

rule.none: No rule: {type} by default. Check it.

simulation.nothingToDo: There's nothing to import: everything is already in GNERAI OS or has errors.
simulation.clientsSummary: This will create {create, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}} and complete {update}. {error, plural, =0 {} one {# row with an error is skipped.} other {# rows with errors are skipped.}}
simulation.invoicesSummary: This will import {create, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} ({total}) and {clients, plural, =0 {no new clients} one {# new client} other {# new clients}}. {error, plural, =0 {} one {# with an error is skipped.} other {# with errors are skipped.}}
simulation.confirmBody: It's simulated again with the current state, and whatever comes out as “create” or “complete” is saved. Invoices come in already issued: they can't be modified (only corrected).
simulation.committed: Imported: {created} new, {updated} completed, {skipped} skipped, {errors} with errors.

result.title: Import complete
result.summaryClients: {create, plural, one {# client created} other {# clients created}}, {update} completed, {skip} unchanged and {error, plural, =0 {no errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}.
result.summaryInvoices: {create, plural, one {# row imported} other {# rows imported}}, {skip} already there, {error, plural, =0 {no errors} one {# error} other {# errors}} and {clients, plural, =0 {no new clients} one {# new client} other {# new clients}}.

issues.date_future: The invoice date is later than today.
issues.quantity_invalid: Invalid quantity: “{value}” (greater than 0, with 3 decimals at most).
issues.tax_id_control: The NIF “{value}” has the wrong check letter or digit.
issues.tax_id_format: “{value}” isn't a recognizable NIF, NIE, CIF or EU VAT number. If the client is foreign, give their country.
issues.country_unknown: Country not recognized: “{value}”. Use the name or the 2-letter code (FR, PT…).
issues.client_ambiguous: There are several clients called “{name}”: add the NIF so we know which one it is.
issues.db_error: It couldn't be saved. Try again; if it keeps happening, let us know.
issues.email_extra: Only the first email is saved; these are ignored: {value}.
issues.postal_code_padded: Postcode completed with the leading zero that Excel removes: {value}.
issues.phone_scientific: Excel turned the phone number into a number ({value}) and it's been lost: not saved.
issues.website_invalid: The website “{value}” doesn't look like an address: not saved.
issues.terms_invalid: Invalid payment terms (“{value}”): the organization's are used.
issues.language_unknown: Language not recognized (“{value}”): Spanish is used.
issues.source_unknown: There's no source “{value}” in Settings → Pipeline: it's left without a source.
issues.owner_unknown: There's no partner “{value}”: whoever imports becomes the owner.
issues.client_exists: It already exists ({name}) and the file doesn't bring anything new.
issues.field_kept: The profile already has a different value, which is kept: {fields}.
issues.name_conflict: “{name}” already exists with a different NIF ({taxId}): check whether it's the same client.
issues.issuer_missing: Choose the issuer of the invoices (or map the issuer NIF column).
issues.issuer_unknown: There's no issuer with the NIF “{value}”.
issues.issuer_inactive: The issuer wasn't registered on the invoice date: check its registration date in Settings → Issuers.
issues.issuer_archived: The issuer {name} is archived (it's imported anyway).
issues.series_unknown: The issuer doesn't have the series “{value}”.
issues.number_format: The number doesn't follow the format of any of the issuer's series ({formats}). Adjust the series format in Settings → Issuers.
issues.group_inconsistent: The rows of this invoice don't match on “{field}” ({a} / {b}). If it's a per-line value, map it to its line field.
issues.already_imported_differs: Already imported, with different amounts ({total}): it isn't changed. An issued invoice can't be modified; if it had an error, it's corrected.
issues.number_taken: The number {number} already exists for this issuer.
issues.series_order_conflict: It would break the series' date order relative to invoice {number}, issued from GNERAI OS.
issues.series_external_numbering: GNERAI OS has already issued in this series and year with an external provider's numbering: history isn't imported here.
issues.totals_mismatch: The total doesn't add up: the invoice says {expected} and base + VAT − IRPF gives {computed}.
issues.base_mismatch: The invoice base ({expected}) isn't the sum of its lines ({computed}).
issues.vat_mismatch: The invoice VAT ({expected}) doesn't match its lines' VAT ({computed}).
issues.irpf_mismatch: The invoice withholding ({expected}) doesn't match any IRPF rate.
issues.rounding_adjusted: Adjusted {cents} of rounding to match what the invoice printed.
issues.vat_rate_inferred: VAT rate worked out from the amounts: {rate}.
issues.vat_rate_default: No VAT data: the default one is applied ({rate}).
issues.vat_rate_unknown: The VAT rate isn't known: map the rate or VAT amount column, or choose a default VAT.
issues.vat_regime_guessed: VAT at 0%: regime worked out from the client's country ({regime}). Check it.
issues.irpf_inferred: IRPF withholding worked out from the amounts: {rate}.
issues.line_amount_missing: Row {row}: the line amount is missing (price or amount).
issues.line_amount_mismatch: Row {row}: quantity × price doesn't give the line amount; the amount is used.
issues.description_default: Lines without a description: a generic description is used.
issues.rectified_missing: It's a corrective invoice, but the invoice it corrects is missing.
issues.rectified_unknown: The corrected invoice {number} isn't in GNERAI OS or in the file (from the same issuer and client).
issues.rectifying_negated: Corrective invoice with positive amounts: it's imported as negative.
issues.negative_total: Negative total on a standard invoice: if it's a corrective invoice, give the invoice it corrects.
issues.date_order_warning: It's dated earlier than invoice {number} ({date}), which has a lower number.
issues.year_mismatch: The year in the number ({year}) isn't the year of the invoice date.
issues.paid_date_invalid: Invalid payment date (“{value}”): it isn't marked as paid.
issues.paid_unknown: The payment status “{value}” isn't understood: it stays outstanding.
issues.paid_before_issue: The payment date ({date}) is earlier than the invoice date.

export.noIssuers: There are no issuers: add them in Settings → Issuers.
export.hint: CSV/XLSX download the sales ledger. ZIP bundles sales, expenses, payments, receipts without invoices, and available attachments, separated by issuer.
export.readmeImported: Invoices imported from history, which have no PDF in GNERAI OS (they were issued in another tool): {numbers}.
export.readmeMissing: The PDF couldn't be read for: {numbers}.
export.readmeIssuing: {count, plural, one {There's # invoice partly issued} other {There are # invoices partly issued}} in the period: they're not included in the register until they're completed.
export.readmeNoExpenseFile: Expenses without a receipt attached in GNERAI OS: {items}.
export.readmeUnassigned: There are {count} receipts without an invoice and without an assigned issuer in this period. They are not attributed to this issuer.
export.readmeScope: Operational export for accountant review. It excludes bank statements and does not certify reconciliation or tax treatment. Check historical imports, attachments, and original documents for completeness.

errors.committed: This import is already confirmed: upload the file again to change the mapping.
errors.mappingIncomplete: Some essential columns still need to be mapped.
errors.commitFailed: The import didn't finish. Whatever got saved isn't duplicated: confirm again.
errors.cannotDelete: A confirmed import can't be discarded: it stays as a record.
